initialImpressions: Graphics are insane<^&^> the map is awesome<^&^> and the elevation and tight turns create an impressive and enjoyable driving experience
review: The lack of content development and evolution draws the game down significantly. It feels like a shell of what it could have been considering its core elements and methods of enjoying the content go unchanged from those used in the entries of the past decade. This is significantly unfortunate as the driving<^&^> graphics<^&^> world<^&^> and experience are amazing<^&^> you just get easily bored of it all<^&^> since it is the same thing you have done the previous 2-3 entries for who knows how many hundreds of hours.
